core.title: Black Walnut Offset Door Pull, First Impressions LKE150060BWTFALSNN

text.description_html:
First Impressions LKE150060BWTFALSNN, 1-1/2" Diameter Offset Black Walnut Door Pull

The Black Walnut Offset Door Pull is from First Impression's Lewis Collection. It is 60" overall length with 1.5" diameter and has satin nickel brackets. This door handle can be thru-bolt mounted, surface mounted, or back-to back mounted.

Specifications for the First Impressions Lewis Wood Door Handle:

  • Pull Handle Material: Solid Black Walnut
  • Pull Bracket Material: Aluminum
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"

Note: This wood door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

When Selecting a Mounting Hardware:

  • Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.
  • Surface Mounting: Pull screws to the face of the door.
  • Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Requires 2 pulls.

Sold individually (1 door pull handle). If you order Back-to-Back Mounting please Order 2 Pulls.
